sections.Profile:
The Miss Nessie pinball machine, released by Sega Enterprises, Ltd. in 1978, is a solid-state, single-player machine themed around the famous Loch Ness monster.

- Manufacturer: Sega Enterprises, Ltd.
- Years made: 1978
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Myth and Legend, Myth, Original Theme, 1970s, Solid State, Monsters
